question: Can one bounded checker consume the delivered golden-ratio resource set, distinguish the four receipt kinds the atlas asks for, independently re-derive its exact identities in a different encoding, and refuse its eight listed corrections?
level: Documentary resource integrity plus external exact arithmetic; no stable semantic operation, no native witness, no Rust authority
objects: staged resource set: atlas, delivery container, external checker and record, illustration source and rendering, delivery digest record, captured source PDF, seven plates
K = Q[u]/(u^2-u-1) with the real embedding 1 < u < 2, encoded as integer pairs (p,q) for (p+q*sqrt(5))/2
Fibonacci and Lucas sequences, convergent brackets, the matrix M=[[1,1],[1,0]] and its powers
the affine word abbbaBAAB, its parameter controls and the figure-eight arithmetic parameter t=phi^2
the HNN affine realization u:x->x+1, v:x->x+phi, t:x->phi^-2 x and its commuting shadow
rectangle R0=[0,phi]x[0,1] under S(x,y)=(phi-y/phi, x/phi), nested images, residual area and diameter
twelve icosahedron vertices, their 66 pairwise squared distances, edge graph and triangular faces
the A->AB, B->A substitution, and the golden-section interval contraction with and without reuse

types.exact_field: integer coefficient pair (p,q) meaning (p+q*sqrt(5))/2; conjugation is q -> -q; norm is (p^2-5q^2)/4; sign uses rational squares; zero has no inverse
types.rationals: fractions.Fraction for convergent brackets, interval widths and search traces
types.receipts: four labelled kinds, each carrying the twelve fields declared by the atlas: question_id, object_type, arithmetic_domain, embedding, expression_or_word, evaluation_order, frame, assumptions, fuel_used, claim_scope, witness, residual
types.resources: staged bytes with SHA256 and byte counts from adva-library/golden-ratio/index.json
types.plates: structure only: media type and pixel dimensions; content is not read

quantifiers: All 15 staged artifacts against their recorded digests and byte counts
All five delivered SHA256.json claims and all six delivery-container members against the staged copies
All 310 recorded check names of the delivered external checker, replayed once in a bounded child process
The Fibonacci power and Cassini identities for every 1 <= n <= 24, and the convergent bracket for every 1 <= n <= 24
Every unordered pair among the twelve icosahedron vertices, 66 squared distances
Every one of the eight atlas corrections as a refusal control
Both search objectives for exactly 12 contraction steps, with and without observation reuse
No unbounded search, no random sampling, no transcendental evaluation
assumptions: The delivered atlas, checker, record, plates and PDF are inputs supplied by the direction; the delivered Python checker is an external oracle, not the Rust semantic kernel
A plate or a captured PDF is a source object or illustration and never a witness for an arithmetic or geometric claim
Digests record byte integrity only; they are not authentication, semantic identity or proof
The four receipt kinds are labels over one checker and do not by themselves establish a general receipt calculus

The integer-pair encoding and the delivered rational-pair encoding are two representations of one field; agreement between them is evidence for these finite instances, not a general translation theorem
protected: No native word, Rust type, IR version, Lisp builtin or stable API is added or changed
No contraction, memoization or CSE is authorized by exact value equality
The Pascal-rooted geometry growth obligation stays Open; admitted geometry successors stay at zero
The delivered resource directory is left untouched; staged copies are byte-identical
No transcendental evaluator, no float acceptance path and no unbounded loop is introduced
acceptance: Every staged artifact matches its recorded sha256 and byte count; the delivered digest claims and all container members agree with the staged copies
The PDF probe recovers the title, the creation date, the article revision identifier cited by the atlas and a well-formed trailer
The delivered checker replays with identical status, identical check count and an identical check-name list; timing and platform fields are excluded rather than compared

The independent integer-pair derivations pass for the field laws, Fibonacci powers, Cassini, convergent brackets, matrix powers, the word residual and its two controls, the HNN relations and their commuting shadow, rectangle images, coverage and residual, the fixed point, icosahedral incidence, the two hyperbolic cosh values, the substitution counts and the bounded search traces
All eight atlas corrections are refused by an executable control
Four receipt kinds are emitted with all twelve declared fields, and each relabeling refusal holds
The three golden rectangle boundaries are pairwise disjoint while their filled sets share an interior point, and the translated-copy and nearby-copy controls behave as declared.
unknown: Any budget, bound, digest or replay failure is reported as Unknown or Invalid and never promoted to partial acceptance
replay: python3 -S experiments/golden_ratio/calibration.py --output target/golden-ratio-fresh.json (the output path must not exist)

amendments.addition: Exact boundary-disjointness checks for the three mutually perpendicular golden rectangles determined by the twelve icosahedron vertices, with two controls: a translated copy whose boundary must be detected as meeting, and a nearby copy whose crossings fall at the other golden half-extent and must not.
amendments.reason: The atlas lists this configuration as its Borromean candidate. The first execution verified the vertex, edge and face incidence but left the boundary structure unconstructed.
amendments.effect_on_scope: The question, objects, types, protected list, budget and unknown policy are unchanged. The acceptance list gains the boundary obligation below.
